title: 1 Hour Philadelphia Private Guided Tour by Deluxe Electric Car
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be 8 years or older
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Philadelphia's history and famous attractions on board a sustainable electric car tour. Our live guide will share stories behind every passing landmark as you travel back in time on a modern ride through the city on one of our eco friendly electric cars (price includes 4 passenger).
